items.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia CEO Huang over Chinese scandal
items.summary: Investing.com-- U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday that the FBI was investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a Chinese businesswoman who was allegedly a spy for Beijing.
